code='''from collections import deque\ndef transform(grid):\n    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in g))\n    seen=set()\n    for r in range(h):\n      for c in range(w):\n        if g[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue\n        q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; edge=False\n        while q:\n          y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x)); edge |= y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1\n          for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):\n            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and g[yy][xx]==bg and (yy,xx) not in seen: seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))\n        if not edge:\n          color=2 if len(comp)%2==0 else 7\n          for y,x in comp:g[y][x]=color\n    return g\n'''
